verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight`, so only 3 of the 4 projection matrices per layer are cast: 48 tensors become bfloat16 instead of the required 64, and the 16 `attention.dense.weight` tensors are written as float32. This violates Required result clause 1 (cast exactly the 64 listed projection matrices to bfloat16). The required check is also mis-implemented: `assert sum(...) == 48` encodes the wrong constant instead of the specified "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16", so it passes silently rather than failing loudly on this exact error. The remaining behaviour (buffer deletion, 196-tensor count, name preservation, shard packing and index) matches the spec.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
